skyzh.option.displayPriority.tooltip:
Other utility mods can also change displayed text, which may prevent translations from appearing correctly.
Adjust this option to give translated text higher display priority.
This can disable some features of other mods. Change it only when necessary!
- Default: Keep compatibility with other utility mods.
- High: Increase the display priority of translated text.
- Force: Give translated text the highest priority and block changes that could interfere with it.
skyzh.options.title: SkyZH Settings
skyzh.option.enabled.tooltip: Whether the mod translates anything at all.
skyzh.option.translateSkyBlockName: Translate the SkyBlock game mode name
skyzh.option.translateSkyBlockName.toolt: Translate the game mode name SkyBlock as 空岛生存.
skyzh.option.originalTips.tooltip: When a server message mentions a translated item, explain which key toggles original text. Press again to restore translations. Disable to hide these hints.
skyzh.option.helpImproveTranslation.tool: Whether to report untranslated text or translation-format errors found in game to the developer server. Not available yet.
skyzh.option.requiresEnabled: Enable the mod first to use this feature.
skyzh.option.captureUntranslated.tooltip: Records untranslated text and mistranslations to a file in the game directory as they are found. Leave this off unless you are a developer.
skyzh.option.captureNotifications.toolti: Report newly captured untranslated text, colour, mixed-language, alignment, continuation and numeric issues in chat.
skyzh.option.autoClearCapture.tooltip: Automatically clear text captured during the previous session each time the game starts.
